        ctx.invoke(login)

def render_email_note(auth: Auth) ->str:
    return "(email verification required)"

def render_successful_login(auth: Auth, organization: Optional[str]=None
    ) ->None:
    console.print()
    console.print("[green]You're authenticated[/green]")
    email_note = ""
    if not is_email_verified({"email_verified": auth.email_verified}):
        email_note = f" {render_email_note(auth)}"
    account_info = f" Account: {auth.name}, {auth.email}{email_note}"
    console.print(account_info)
    console.print()
    if not is_email_verified({"email_verified": auth.email_verified}):
        console.print(MSG_FINISH_REGISTRATION_TPL.format(email=auth.email))
        console.print(MSG_VERIFICATION_HINT)

@auth_app.command(name=CMD_LOGIN_NAME, help=CLI_AUTH_LOGIN_HELP)
def login(ctx: typer.Context, headless: Annotated[Optional[bool], typer.
    Option('--headless', help=CLI_AUTH_HEADLESS_HELP)]=None) ->None:
    LOG.info('login started')
    fail_if_authenticated(ctx, with_msg=MSG_FAIL_LOGIN_AUTHED)
    uri, initial_state = get_authorization_data(client=ctx.obj.auth.client,
                                                code_verifier=ctx.obj.auth.code_verifier,
                                                organization=ctx.obj.auth.org)
    console.print()
    console.print("Redirecting your browser to log in; once authenticated, return here to start using Safety")
    console.print()
    info = process_browser_callback(uri, initial_state=initial_state, ctx=ctx,
                                    headless=headless if headless is not None else False)
    if info:
        ctx.obj.auth.email = info.get("email")
        ctx.obj.auth.name = info.get("name")
        ctx.obj.auth.email_verified = False
        organization = None
        if ctx.obj.auth.org and ctx.obj.auth.org.name:
            organization = ctx.obj.auth.org.name
        render_successful_login(ctx.obj.auth, organization=organization)
    else:
        console.print('[red]Unable to log in at this time, try again.[/red]')
